name: 60642 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60642 (Chicago) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60642 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60642 (Chicago) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
